title: Problem Card v2 and the fit verdict: the framework's fields filled or owned, never blocking, and G2's three verdicts with the card edits a person accepts
request: Phase 8 (the owner's retail interview): the problem card's missing fields, G1 on what changes the solution, a data card with its detected modifiers and a three-way fit verdict, and G2.
plan: Read the framework's card and gate definitions, and map what blocks a build today.
Add the fields to the problem card as filled or owned, never blocking, so Home and the journeys behave as before.
Give the data card each column's availability and the modifiers its rows show; turn the meet check into three verdicts.
Let a person accept a verdict's edits as their answers, and record the verdict at a build.

decisions.decision: The new fields never block; their open questions are kept apart from the card's questions.
decisions.why: Only what changes the solution blocks G1, and the written people of the journeys cannot answer an owner or a baseline: a blocking field would stop them.

decisions.decision: G2 is a verdict beside the existing mismatch questions, not a new coordinator step.
decisions.why: A new step changes every walk and the harness's graded sequences; the mismatches already block a build where the verdict would.

decisions.decision: The data card's modifiers are read on exactly the rows the proposal may read.
decisions.why: The rows a later holdout takes must never shape a card that proposes edits; one reading in the library serves both.

decisions.decision: The modifiers' facts moved into the library.
decisions.why: A data card reads them too, and the library never imports the studio.

change: dclab_core.card ProblemCard v2 (ErrorCosts, Capacity, Success, OpenField, capacity_said, costs_said); dclab_core.datacard DataCard v4 (known_at_prediction, DetectedModifier, detected_modifiers, fit); dclab_core.meet FitVerdict v1 and fit; dclab_core.modifiers facts_of, label_source_columns and provisional_reading; the ledger point data.fit_verdict; the adapter's card_v2; the draft's card reading Home's answers, meeting with the verdict, accept_fit and its route; dclab-core 0.89.0.

findings.scenario: from dclab_core import modifiers: the contracts loaded the data card, which asked the half-loaded modifiers for Detected.
findings.cause: The data card imported the modifiers at module level.
findings.fix: The data card keeps its own DetectedModifier contract.

findings.defect: Realistic capacity answers crashed the draft's card.
findings.scenario: '15,000,000 transactions a month and can review 300 a day' raised; '40,000 orders a day; two analysts check 150 a day' read 40000; 'since 2019' read 2019 a day.
findings.cause: The first number before a period was taken, unbounded, and a parse error raised.
findings.fix: Every candidate read, the one beside a word of acting first, years and out-of-range numbers skipped, a thousands suffix read; a reading that fails leaves the field open.

findings.scenario: Accepting labels=column left the stated family anomaly, so the same edit came back.
findings.cause: The edit changed the labels, not the family the mismatch reads.
findings.fix: The edit is the family: a rare event.

findings.defect: A refused outcome always read as does not fit.
findings.scenario: customer_id named while churned is in the table: missing an outcome column.
findings.cause: The data card keeps no candidate once a named outcome is refused.
findings.fix: Other outcome-like columns proposed; missing only when there are none.

findings.defect: The unit edit could be nonsense and clear a real mismatch.
findings.scenario: 'one row per no column or set of three tells the rows apart'.
findings.cause: The table's grain sentence was copied as a unit.
findings.fix: One row by the table's key, or one row of the table, said as predicting per row.

findings.defect: An accepted edit could be ignored after a wizard save.
findings.scenario: The saved solution's target and kind are read before the answers.
findings.fix: An edit the saved solution owns is refused with where to change it; an edit that would come back is undone.

findings.defect: The card's modifiers read rows a holdout takes.
findings.scenario: The earliest 80% by time, against the repository's 75% rule for time to event.
findings.cause: A new cut instead of the existing one.
findings.fix: The proposal's own provisional reading, moved into the library and used by both.

findings.defect: Every time column was marked known at prediction time.
findings.scenario: A chargeback date written after the outcome read as known.
findings.fix: A time is unknown until a person names it; a label source is never known.

findings.defect: The new point's state gave away its answer.
findings.scenario: The counts of edits and missing data decide the verdict exactly.
findings.cause: The verdict's outputs were written as its evidence.
findings.fix: The state holds what the verdict read: the mismatches, the family, the labels, a time column, noisy labels.

findings.defect: The point's truth was never recorded.
findings.scenario: Accepting wrote nothing to the ledger, no event.
findings.cause: The route only changed the draft.
findings.fix: The person's decision recorded beside the rule's, and an event Home redraws on.

findings.defect: The accept route was untested and one message false.
findings.scenario: A draft with no table was told the data fits; a string of fields became letters.
findings.fix: No table said; fields validated as a list; HTTP tests.

findings.scenario: An action without costs read as a stated miss cost; plural false alarms missed; 'less than' read the wrong way.
findings.cause: An action fallback and a one-way comparison.
findings.fix: No fallback; plurals; the comparison's direction read.

findings.defect: The main product's size limit could be passed.
findings.scenario: The capacity added after the constraints were checked.
findings.fix: Checked again with it, left out with a note when over.

findings.defect: The data card's verdict field was never filled.
findings.fix: A build stores its verdict in the draft's card, which the project copies.

findings.defect: The page never heard the new fit event.
findings.scenario: test_the_page_listens_to_every_kind_of_event_a_draft_emits listed fit as emitted and unheard.
findings.cause: The page's stream lists its event kinds by hand.
findings.fix: fit listened to; Home redraws its understanding on it.

measurements.name: the dev journeys with the new fields
measurements.gate: the Done when: the dev journeys pass
measurements.result: JRN-026: 15 of 15 journeys right, 0 moves refused; JRN-027 after the review's fixes: 15 of 15
measurements.against_gate: Every dev journey passes with the v2 card and the v4 data card.

outcome: The card holds the framework's fields without stopping anyone, and the data now says whether it fits the problem, with the edits a person accepts.
lessons: A new field on a card the agents read must say who can answer it before it may ask anyone.
Move a contract's version only with a reader for every stored version, and write the new baseline once, after the shape settles.
risks: G2 is not a coordinator step yet: a verdict's edits are proposed, accepted through the route, and nothing waits for them.
